courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 河道分洪工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「含水量與乾密度機理與驗證」與「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；河道分洪工程的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification" and "Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of River flood-diversion works must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦區分夯實、地基壓密與防滲失效的土堤推導；河道分洪工程則以從分流連續到回水與下游影響的分洪道分析為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on levee reasoning that separates compaction, consolidation and seepage failure; River flood-diversion works centres on floodway analysis from flow division to backwater and downstream effects, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「含水量與乾密度」與「分流控制體與受益範圍」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到河道分洪工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Moisture and dry density” and “Diversion control volume and effects”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to River flood-diversion works, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 防洪牆基礎設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「含水量與乾密度機理與驗證」與「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；防洪牆基礎設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification" and "Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Floodwall foundation design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦區分夯實、地基壓密與防滲失效的土堤推導；防洪牆基礎設計則以從靜水力到接觸與變形的防洪牆基礎推導為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on levee reasoning that separates compaction, consolidation and seepage failure; Floodwall foundation design centres on floodwall foundation reasoning from hydrostatic action to contact and movement, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「含水量與乾密度」與「靜水荷載與作用點」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到防洪牆基礎設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「被動土壓與可動員變形機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Moisture and dry density” and “Hydrostatic load and lever arm”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Floodwall foundation design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Passive pressure and mobilization mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 土堤壓密與防滲
history.text: 墾務局於2011年發布土石壩濾層章、2012年發布填築施工章，2014年滲流章進一步區分出口隆起與其他侵蝕機制。這些文件提供可轉用的土工機理，不是所有地區堤防的驗收規範。工兵團2013年公告西沙加緬度南河路退縮堤防防滲牆完成，並指出堤體已於前一年完成；不與南港其他分期工程混淆。曼尼托巴官方另列紅河分洪系統西堤。本課不把教學密度、滲透係數或施工時程歸屬上述工程。
history.textEn: Reclamation published its embankment-dam filter chapter in 2011, construction chapter in 2012 and seepage chapter in 2014, distinguishing exit heave from other erosion mechanisms. These provide transferable geotechnical principles, not universal levee acceptance criteria. A 2013 Corps announcement reports completion of the South River Road setback-levee cutoff in West Sacramento and identifies the embankment as completed the previous year; it is not conflated with other Southport phases. Manitoba separately identifies the Floodway West Dike. Lesson densities, conductivities and timing are not attributed to these projects.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「含水量與乾密度機理與驗證」到「孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification" through "Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
